title: {{APP_TITLE}}: recommendation lifecycle
description: Every 15 min: snapshots log and CPU-throttling signals for the easytrade namespace, asks Davis (auto-adaptive anomaly detection) to confirm throttling, then opens new recommendations and resolves ones that stayed clean for two runs. State is stored as business events (easytrade.insights.recommendation) that the EasyTrade Insights app reads.

throttle.name: throttle
throttle.description: CPU throttling % per container, last hour

input.query:
timeseries {thr=sum(dt.kubernetes.container.cpu_throttled), used=sum(dt.kubernetes.container.cpu_usage)}, by:{k8s.container.name}, filter:k8s.namespace.name=="{{NAMESPACE}}", from:now()-1h, interval:1h
| fieldsAdd t=arraySum(thr), u=arraySum(used)
| fields container=k8s.container.name, throttlePct=round(if(t+u>0, t/(t+u)*100, else:0.0), decimals:1)

logs.name: logs
logs.description: Log level hygiene per container, last hour

input.query:
fetch logs, from:now()-1h
| filter k8s.namespace.name=="{{NAMESPACE}}"
| summarize logs=count(), noLevel=countIf(isNull(loglevel) or loglevel=="NONE"), info=countIf(loglevel=="INFO"), by:{container=k8s.container.name}
| fieldsAdd noLevelPct=round(noLevel*100.0/logs, decimals:1), infoPct=round(info*100.0/logs, decimals:1)
| fields container, logs, noLevelPct, infoPct

previous.name: previous
previous.description: Latest recorded state of every recommendation

input.query:
fetch bizevents, from:now()-30d
| filter event.type=="easytrade.insights.recommendation" and namespace=="{{NAMESPACE}}"
| sort timestamp desc
| summarize status=takeFirst(status), cleanRuns=takeFirst(cleanRuns), davis=takeFirst(davis), by:{container, rule}

reconcile.name: reconcile
reconcile.description: Davis confirmation, open / resolve logic, writes state events
